propositions: rebar-debug closes defect tickets without recording the originating ticket that caused the defect, making defect escape rate unmeasurable

The fallback blame derivation fails on two systematic cases: charges the defect to whoever wrote most of the file rather than the defect author, and cannot detect unmet-obligation scenarios where fix site differs from cause site
Attribution step must be added to Phase 1 Stage 3 exit gate before RCA writeback to identify originating ticket via blame of implicated lines, then record it with --caused-by flag on close
The fix-site-is-not-cause-site case (producer change creates obligation, consumer never updated) requires explicit detection via date test and producer-side git history search
Four attribution resolutions are required: regression, unmet obligation, omission by scope-of-work, and unattributable, with only unattributable falling back to recorded negative result
Both rebar-debug and rebar-implement skill bootstrap must use make worktree with virtualenv on PATH for all commands to avoid pre-commit hook failures from missing tools like ruff/mypy
